meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Movie & TV Castmates Play Who's Who, Abbott Elementary & Mean Girls Cast Play Character Game, October Celebrity Birthday Spotlight, Tina Fey & Wiz Khalifa Play With Puppies, Best Of Puppy Interviews
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
